diagnosis: The scenario failed the Weak Arm gate because the model was able to satisfy all duty assignment decisions by using generic placeholders (e.g., 'One person with Movement Control authorization') instead of specific names like Sgt. Hale or Cpl. Singh. This allowed the model to bypass the requirement for private facts PF1, PF2, PF3, and PF4, as it could fulfill the functional requirements of the roles without knowing which specific individual held the necessary certifications.
